end.summary:
Practised converting distances to the same unit before comparing.
Arjun correctly explained that 1 metre equals 100 centimetres and 1 kilometre equals 1000 metres.
They solved 250 cm = 2.5 m and 2 km 75 m = 2075 m with verbal reasoning.
Subtraction and ordering mixed-unit distances were also practised; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised changing distances into one unit before comparing them. They explained several conversions aloud, including 250 centimetres as 2.5 metres and 2 kilometres 75 metres as 2075 metres. There was a mix-up while ordering the final set of distances, and it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise two or three short examples by converting every distance to metres first, then ordering them.
